title: There is no Red There
text: There is no Red There. I'm returning these.  Not only does it feel like something you'd find in a cheap hotel (I have high standards for my hotels and my shower curtains), the fabric was Snagged, and there were black dots in the fabric.  I don't know about you, but I'm not hanging something in my bathroom that already has black dots on it.  Looks like mold.  i'm sure it isn't , but it says a lot about their quality control.  Also, I got the "Red".  It isn't "Red" at all.  It's more of a light burgundy.  The color of dried blood.  Really not appealing.  And Really not Red.  This was such a disappointment.  Not at All like the color in the picture.  I would never buy these again.  And the black dots!  What's that about?!?!

description: Spruce up your bathroom décor with the Ombre Leaves Shower Curtain Collection by Creative Home Ideas.
